title: Model repair
summary: After a game update, brings mod models made for an earlier version of the game up to the current format so that they load again. The original files are kept, and every repair can be undone.

reading: Reading the models of the game and the mods…
intro: A game update can stop mod models made for the earlier version from loading. A repair updates their version, vertex formats and, where needed, detail levels to the game's current ones. The original files are kept, and every repair can be undone. Deploy afterwards to apply the changes in game.
